overall_summary: Overall view counts remain low across the board (mostly under 50 views), making statistical certainty limited. However, content focusing heavily on 'self respect' with micro-actions related to digital life (deleting chats, hiding last seen, removing pinned notes) tends to slightly outperform broader romantic pain topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos referencing concrete smartphone actions like changing status lists, unpinning chats, or hiding last seen (e.g., rwOUYo_hayQ, AfaLxMy6FMY) garnered relative highs of 41 views.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-interactions within smartphone apps (keyboard history, call logs, settings toggles) that symbolize emotional detachment.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' (G0gKV1p3ZHc) or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (uIbMpCjVutQ) received significantly fewer views (6-13 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic atmospheric intros and anchor the opening into an immediate, tangible object or digital action.
